title: Linearity bounds for APN functions
summary: For $n\ge5$, let $F\colon\mathbb{F}_2^n\to \mathbb{F}_2^n$ be almost perfect nonlinear and write $N=2^n$. It is proven that the linearity $\mathcal{L}(F)$ of $F$, i.e., the largest absolute Walsh coefficient of a nonzero component, is at most $N-6$. If $n$ is even, it is further proven that $\mathcal{L}(F)\le N-\sqrt N/4-2$. These bounds improve the general upper bound of $N-4$ in odd dimension and $N-6$ in even dimensions $n \geq 10$.
